nodes.label: CMDB configuration item detail (EN)
nodes.rationale: CMDB CI detail in English. Two-column card layout: attribute table on the left and right, with Tags and External IDs cards below. Shows a hypervisor CI (nutanix_ahv, rack DMM-COLO-DH01-A-01, Dell ProSupport warranty). The left column is empty in this capture. Edit affordances are the tag chips and the add-tag input.

nodes.label: CI attribute table
nodes.rationale: Monospace attribute keys (partNumber to warrantyProvider) with bold values in a key-value grid. Dates are shown in long form. Read-first layout so each value can be scanned against its key.

nodes.label: Tags panel
nodes.rationale: Removable chips with an x control plus an Add a tag input. Chips show a generated e2e tag, hardware and hypervisor.

nodes.label: External IDs panel
nodes.rationale: Empty state reads that no external system references this CI yet. The card stays in place so the slot is visible before an integration populates it.
